references.observed: Crest view shows the curved road, three top spillway bays, twin square control huts, red-roof utility buildings, blue rails, and two visible tunnel portals.
Downstream view shows projecting spillway piers, board-marked concrete, a lower inspection gallery, recessed circular outlet mouths and the approach beside the cliff.
The owner lists the 678 m crest, 220 m structural height, 268 m crest length, three 13 by 5 m crest bays, three midlevel and two foundation outlets.
The PMTiles crest road, approach tunnels, lake and downstream river give the signed model frame.
